plan.title: A reading plan's proof is a short voice recap in their own words, with a why and an easy alternative

context.text: finish Atomic Habits this month, then keep going with more books
Love that. Every night, or a few nights a week?

transcript.text:
Finishing Atomic Habits this month and then moving on to more books is a great goal. Here's the plan:

• Headed for: finish Atomic Habits this month, then keep going with more books
• Tonight's step: read Atomic Habits in bed for 20 minutes from where you are, starting at 9:15 pm
• Schedule: every day at 9:15 pm, 20 minutes, in bed
• Proof: a short voice note recapping what you read, in your own words. It helps the ideas stick. If you can't talk, a photo of your page works too.
• I'll text you a bit before 9:15 each night.

Each night's reading shapes the next step, so we keep you on pace for the finish line. What do you think?
Glad it works, Priya. Are you committing to this, every night at 9:15 pm, starting tonight?
